03 / Process

Clear from first idea to final file.

01

Define

Reference, purpose, silhouette, identity and required deliverables are established.

02

Construct

Panel structure, proportions, closures, materials and physical details are worked through.

03

Specify

Dimensions, embroidery placement, logo scale and production notes are documented.

04

Visualize

Product views and presentation imagery communicate how the finished product should look.

05

Deliver

Organized production-ready files are prepared for review, sampling and manufacturing.

04 / About

Precision with a product mindset.

Guled Hassen works at the intersection of technical design, product development and creative direction, with a particular focus on headwear and branded products.

The approach is engineering-minded: define the object, document the construction, make the visual language consistent, then prepare the work so another person can understand and build from it.
